answer: Where did the ember come from? Who painted the wander? When was the grove finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. Every applicant faces the same trial, Mews keeper gyrfalcon mark flown at the training field, and every verdict reads the same way: each gyrfalcon is a season of logged flights plus a signed mews record. An honest proof costs 190 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 510 of them, which totals 96900 POA.
